notes:
Flown legs: when a mission ends early — most do, on a battery RTL — the app
now files what was actually flown as its own entry under the plan, with
where it joined the survey and where it turned for home. RERUN uploads just
that portion instead of the whole plan again.

The Herelink's A, B, C, D and Home buttons now do something: Loiter, Auto,
Land, Alt Hold and RTL. A new Button modes switch in Config turns them back
off if you'd rather they stayed inert.

Config also gets a Flight history switch, to hide the flown-leg rows if you
don't want them listed, and a tidier one-row-per-setting layout.

Smaller fixes: the on-screen keyboard's shift key now behaves like a normal
shift (double-tap for caps lock), a debug build no longer needs the release
keystore to configure, and a debug APK now builds automatically on every
push to develop.
